description: Ministry of Ports & Shipping  - Notify the Sri lanka Ports Authority Act No. 51 of 1979 - pertaining Port of Galle
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the legal definition and specification of Galle Port limits under the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act.
